_readme: Every truck here is REAL and carries a `source` naming where it was confirmed.
NEVER add a truck you cannot source, and NEVER invent a cuisine or a description.
An empty `cuisine` or `desc` is CORRECT and intended: the page renders without it and the
claim-your-listing link is how the owner fills it in. A guessed cuisine on a real business
is a factual error about someone's livelihood, which is worse than a blank field.
Run `python build_directory.py` after editing. Do NOT hand-edit the generated HTML.

areas.name: Kahului
areas.blurb: Central Maui's truck capital. Most of these are clustered at Plate Lunch Marketplace on Haleakala Highway, across from the Costco gas station, plus the harbour and Dairy Road lots.

areas.name: Wailuku
areas.blurb: Wailuku trucks skew local and family-run, spread along Kahekili Highway and through town rather than gathered in one lot.

areas.name: Kihei
areas.blurb: South Maui is home to Kihei Food Oasis at South Maui Gardens, voted the best food truck pod on the island, with trucks on both the north side (30 Alahele Place) and south side (35 Auhana Road).

areas.name: West Maui
areas.blurb: The Honoapiilani food truck courtyard on Lower Honoapiilani Road, on the Ka'anapali and Honokowai border, is the heart of the west side scene. Most trucks come alive around 5:30pm.

areas.name: Upcountry
areas.blurb: Upcountry's trucks gather around Kulamalu in Pukalani and along the Kula Highway, serving the cooler slopes of Haleakala.

areas.name: North Shore
areas.blurb: Haiku and Paia trucks lean small, independent and surprising, with a strong showing around the old Haiku cannery and marketplace.

areas.name: Hana
areas.blurb: At the end of the Road to Hana, a tight cluster of trucks feeds nearly everyone who makes the drive. Hours are short and things sell out, so go early.

trucks.name: Geste Shrimp Truck
trucks.desc: Maui’s famous garlic shrimp (and hot dogs), usually parked on Kahului Beach Rd by the MACC.

trucks.name: Thai Mee Up
trucks.desc: ‘Aipono Award Best Food Truck (2018 and 2022). Thai done Maui-style, now at Plate Lunch Marketplace, Kihei Food Oasis and Kula.
trucks.source: existing listing; South Maui Gardens tenant list; Yelp Pukalani 2026-08

trucks.name: Like Poke
trucks.desc: Fresh, well-priced poke. Voted Best Food Truck Lunch 2023 by Maui Time readers.

trucks.name: Ono Teppanyaki & Seafood
trucks.desc: Thai Mee Up’s sister truck: teppanyaki and seafood, plate-lunch style.

trucks.name: Tacos Maui
trucks.desc: Street tacos and burritos at Plate Lunch Marketplace near the airport.

trucks.name: Mo’Ono Hawai’i
trucks.desc: Açaí bowls from a recipe perfected over three years. Bright and fresh.

trucks.name: Kalei’s Lunch Box
trucks.desc: A go-to for local comfort grindz, working Kahului, Wailuku and Pukalani.

trucks.name: Da Soriano Grindz
trucks.desc: Big, hearty island plate lunches with a loyal following.
trucks.source: existing listing; Yelp Kahului and Wailuku 2026-08

trucks.name: 808 Plates Maui
trucks.desc: A long-running Kahului plate-lunch truck and one of the most reviewed on the island.
trucks.source: Yelp Kahului 2026-08 (467 reviews); Maui No Ka Oi directory

trucks.name: Plantation Plates
trucks.desc: Family-run Hawaii comfort food on Haleakala Hwy: loco moco, kalua pork and hamburger steak.

trucks.name: Havens
trucks.desc: Smash burgers and crinkle fries at Plate Lunch Marketplace. Won Best Burger on Maui in 2022.
trucks.source: Yelp Kahului 2026-08; The Hawaii Vacation Guide 2026-07

trucks.name: Suns Out Buns Out
trucks.desc: Inventive handcrafted bao buns, on Piikea Ave in Kihei and at Plate Lunch Marketplace.

trucks.name: ‘Ula‘Ula Cafe
trucks.desc: Farm-inspired food served fresh on Kahekili Hwy, from the ʻāina to your plate.
trucks.source: Yelp Wailuku 2026-08 (170 reviews); own Facebook page

trucks.name: Tagpuan
trucks.desc: Filipino street food in Wailuku: lumpia, siomai and pork sisig.

trucks.name: Kitoko Maui
trucks.desc: Creative fusion plates, bentos and a seafood platter at South Maui Gardens, 35 Auhana Rd.
trucks.source: existing listing; South Maui Gardens tenant list

trucks.name: Kina’ole Grill
trucks.desc: Local plates and standout seared ahi, steps from Kamaole Beach I.

trucks.name: Horhitos Mobile Taqueria
trucks.desc: One of Maui’s OG trucks: street tacos, local plates, burgers and mac salad.

trucks.name: South Maui Fish Company
trucks.desc: Fresh-caught seafood by Azeka. Locally sourced, prepared to order.

trucks.name: Wing Kings
trucks.desc: Chicken wings served with aloha at Kihei Food Oasis, north side.

trucks.name: Sweet Hula
trucks.desc: Açaí bowls with fresh and plant-based options, good for breakfast or lunch.

trucks.name: Burger Boys
trucks.desc: Wagyu burgers at Kihei Food Oasis.

trucks.name: Da Sweet Spot by Bling Bing

trucks.name: Voyage Maui Sushi

trucks.name: Little Pink Taco Truck Maui
trucks.desc: A tiny pink truck blending Mexican, Hawaiian and Baja flavours.

trucks.name: Sparkys Food Company
trucks.desc: Family recipes and local Hawaiian cuisine at Kihei Food Oasis.

trucks.name: Myth Legendary Kitchen
trucks.desc: Made-to-order Greek street food from three generations of family recipes.

trucks.name: Nirvana
trucks.desc: Authentic Indian curries and kebabs at Kihei Food Oasis.

trucks.name: SŌKAI Maui

trucks.name: Bacon & Blossom

trucks.name: Alaska’s Aloha
trucks.desc: Alaskan seafood with a Hawaiian twist.

trucks.name: The Garden Market & Deli
trucks.desc: Handcrafted sandwiches on house-baked focaccia and fresh salads, south side of the Gardens.

trucks.name: Blue Door Bakery
trucks.desc: A fully organic bakery turning out artisan bread and sourdough pizza.

trucks.name: Da Green Coffee Bar

trucks.name: 808 Grindz

trucks.name: El Taco Borracho

trucks.name: Thai Food By Suri

trucks.source: Maui Resort Rentals park guide, updated 2026-01

trucks.name: Da Food Anchor

trucks.name: Kaya Sushi

trucks.source: Maui Resort Rentals park guide, updated 2026-01

trucks.name: Vida’s Coffee
